weapon.d: Grants Spd+3. If unit's HP ≥ 50%, allies within 2 spaces can move to a space adjacent to unit.

assist.d: Grants Spd+4 to target ally for 1 turn.
Grants Spd/Res+3 to target ally for 1 turn.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.

b.d: At the start of every fourth turn, restores 10 HP.
At the start of every third turn, restores 10 HP.
At start of odd-numbered turns, restores 10 HP.

c.d: Grants Def+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk/Def+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk/Def+3 to adjacent allies during combat.
